column1: # APD Change History. Tester builds only. Gaps between published builds are rebuilt from commit history.
# Icons: i:NAME = Icons, c:NAME = ChangeIcons, s:NAME = ItemSpriteSheet. Body: \n = new line, **x** = highlight.

column4: I'm working on this change history first. After that, the **Cleric Grudge** design and the leftover **talent description** audit are next.\n\nAnything marked "Developer build" only exists in my own test build until I say it's ready for Alpha Testers.
This screen! The **Changes** button now opens an SPD-style history of every APD tester build, grouped into tabs by build number.

Tapping the **magnifying glass** now searches anywhere in a room that still has a wall that could hide a door. It used to switch to Inspect unless you were standing next to that wall.\n\nRooms whose walls can't hide anything still tap to **Inspect**, and holding the button still does the opposite.
**Developer build only:** the game asks the phone for its **highest refresh rate** (144 Hz on the RedMagic). Bug reports record the rate that was asked for.

**Crashes:**\n- Fixed an **out-of-memory crash** during play. The Cleric Grudge was building the whole statistics catalog in the background. It now counts from a small per-run summary.\n- Fixed a crash when picking up an item with a **full backpack** (the swap window was built on the wrong thread).

**Developer build only:**
- A real-world **clock** in the top-right corner.
- **Frame time** under the clock, updated every frame.
- A **stutter probe** that logs every frame slower than 100 ms, with memory in use.
- A **memory spike watcher** that records every thread when the heap jumps.

**One rule for every search control.** The toolbar button, the chooser and the resume window all decide the same way: a full search is worth its turns near a wall that could hide a door, or in a room with **visible traps**.\n\nIn a trap room, tap now always searches and reveals hidden traps instead of falling back to Inspect.

- Rebuildable statistics caches are now **gzip-compressed**, so they take much less space.\n- The diagnostic journal no longer records every drag step. It keeps the **newest 8 MiB** instead of filling to 64 MiB.\n- The trace file is no longer rewritten on every drag frame.

Bug reports can now be **Standard** or **Extended**:
- Extended reports include an **action journal** between reports: moves, attacks, waits, setting changes, scenes, errors and memory milestones. Typed text is never recorded.
- It is **Off by default**. Turning it on shows the full privacy notice first, and turning it off erases the journal.
- Extended reports are saved as a **maximum-compression ZIP**. Standard reports are unchanged.
First build with the opt-in **Extended bug report** and its action journal.

This build merges two lines of work into one game:
- **R7:** new weapons and shields, full-pack swap, throw aiming, Greater Metamorphosis and the adaptive magnifier.
- **C485:** history, diagnostics and performance work, plus the newer seed-reuse scoring.

Passed **3,540 tests** with nothing failing.

Reading saved run history is faster and uses less memory. It reuses buffers, checksums and frame storage instead of allocating new ones for every entry, and stops holding old events when a log reopens.

Replaying a seed you've already played lowers that run's score. The formula went through several versions (cubic, depth-weighted, exponential per floor, then **exact 3/5 per reuse**).\n\nAll saved runs were **corrected retroactively** to the current version.

Many fixes to importing and exporting run history:
- Damaged, aliased or oversized archives are refused **without touching your existing history**.
- Error messages stay short instead of dumping whole files.
- Imports reuse memory instead of reading everything twice.

- Markdown reports keep literal brackets, backticks and asterisks.
- ZIP exports report their real size.
- Report saving no longer leaks a file or finishes twice when a worker fails.
- Diagnostic files always stay inside their own folder.
Android **memory-pressure** warnings are kept in the bug report's heap history, including across background/resume.

**Katana family:** Tanto, Wakizashi, Tachi and Nodachi.
**Shields, tiers 1-5:** Buckler, Targe and Kite Shield.

They use their own sprites and share the normal weapon drop weight. The Katana's guard now scales with upgrades.
**Scroll of Metamorphosis** is back to the original version. **Greater Metamorphosis** is a new spell that lets you pick from any talent in the tier.
Picking up an item with a full backpack now offers to **swap** it with something you're carrying, instead of leaving it on the floor.
Thrown weapons can be aimed at **any visible enemy**, not just the closest one.

The magnifying glass picks the right action for where you are:
- **Tap:** full search near a wall that could hide a door, Inspect elsewhere.
- **Hold:** the opposite.

Rooms that can't hide a door no longer offer Wall Search or get checkmarks. Wall Search won't start on floors without hidden doors.
- The difficulty bar now fades out with the hero select screen.\n- Stale Wall Search sessions from another floor are no longer offered.

**Developer preview.** The hero's idle, death and flying animations play at 1x. Pickups, health numbers, search, spells and other feedback each follow the right speed. Plants, wells, gas and enemy alerts stay at 1x.
Player and enemy **animations and walking** follow your selected playback speed (0.5x-1000x). Environment animations, wells, gas, alerts and the interface stay at 1x.
Only **walking** follows the selected playback speed. Everything else (attacks, particles, alerts, gas, wells) plays at normal speed.

- The difficulty bar on character select now fades properly.\n- Enemy alerts, magical wells and toxic gas no longer play at extreme speed.\n- Using a Well of Health no longer plays its particles sped up.
The contextual Search only checks the area your hero can actually search (class, talents, Foresight) instead of a maximum-size square.
Lots of crash-proofing for damaged or incomplete saves: wall-search memory, trap warnings, stair routes, Rat King search payments and trap confirmations. They now fail safely instead of crashing.
The Search chooser and room checks no longer allocate temporary memory each time they open. Same choices, same order.

Replaying a seed lowers your score based on **earlier local attempts** and the **deepest floor** you reached. Score Breakdown shows the actual penalty.\n- The current run never counts as its own earlier attempt.\n- Damaged saved scores are rejected instead of being recalculated.
Fixed adaptive Search in the middle of rooms and checkmarks in locked rooms.
Copy Seed text now says **ADHD Pixel Dungeon**.
Entering a seed tells you if **you've played it before**, how many attempts, and the deepest floor reached, all from your offline history. Unfinished runs count too.
Search and Wall Search are offered based on your **real search reach** (Rogue 2 tiles, others 1, +1 with Wide Search) and the room you're in.
**Visual playback speed** (0.5x-1000x) is available to every player. Six renameable **Custom Dungeon Rules** preset slots, plus Easiest, Hardest, Default, All Max and All Min.
Gear sorts by category, known upgrade and tier. An unknown curse no longer counts as an unknown upgrade. The Velvet Pouch keeps seeds and stones in separate groups.
Clearer talent and meal descriptions. Fixed singular counts labelled as plural, and two Rogue talents that described their effects wrong.

Clearer **armor abilities** (all 19 checked against the real code), statuses, Ratmogrify, Trinity, buffs and talents.\n**Shield of Light** shows its real 5-turn / 4-turn timers. **Arcana** shows readable percentages.
Shorter status windows (31 of them), staff, bow, plant and food text. Durations are always in turns.
- **Cursed healing** no longer shows 10 HP when it actually healed 0.\n- **Hearty Meal's** healing number respects the Healing rule.
Clearer Cloak, Rose, Talisman, Armband, Toolkit, Hourglass and Spellbook. Dew and the Waterskin warn when your rules prevent healing.
- Fixed a **Sandals crash**.\n- Fixed **Tenacity** wording for positive, negative and zero values.
Clearer Warding, Regrowth and trinket details. **Elemental Blast** shows the real radius and damage, and Monk text is clearer.
Shorter, accurate descriptions for darts, Duelist abilities, exotic potions, wands, Lightning, Living Earth, Prismatic Light, rings, trinkets, elixirs, imbues and scrolls. Numbers stay live.
Descriptions never reveal **unknown curses** or **unidentified upgrades**. The Psionic Blast preview doesn't count invisible creatures or mimics.
Fixed the Chalice cap and Crystal warnings. Opening a wand no longer triggers gameplay cleanup.
Inventory sorts itself automatically: lowest tier first, then lowest known upgrade.
Shorter weapon tooltips. Clearer runestones, spells, keepsakes, journal pages, equipment and trinkets. Item text is no longer clipped on the last line.
- Fixed a **turn-queue stall** when an attack animation was cancelled by death.\n- Guard pulls are safe and throws go straight to the target.
Arcana shows its percentage, and enchantments show before/after values. Selective calculations, plus Cloak and Rose explanations.
Wall-search marks are only placed using **observed** walls, so unseen tiles no longer fake a doorway.
Fixed statistics **memory** problems and item inspection bugs. Optional movement after discovering a trap.
**Visual playback speeds** for Alpha Testers.
Door-checkmark eligibility is complete. Rat King search, loot and **gear origins** were added.
A real **On/Off** toggle. When it's off, a quickslot with one Healing stack drinks directly.
Pick from **8 checkmark colors** under Visibility. Tiles that can't be doorways stay unmarked.
Thrown weapons reach any visible enemy with a clear straight line.
- **Grass dew auto-pickup** (has its own setting and stops when enemies are visible).\n- **Saved manual-search wall markers**.\n- Ring contributions shown in item descriptions.
The **Gathering** icon. Upgrade Scrolls and Strength Potions show pickup counts per region.
Short presses register reliably. Fixed memory leaks from unused statistics catalogs.
Interface scaling and input fixes across display sizes.
A full offline **statistics database**: searchable tables, charts, death context, healing-after-damage windows, turn-by-turn run playback, experiments and CSV export. Multilingual search included.
**20 save slots per class**, with a class-filtered chooser. Old saves stay put.
Waterskin defaults to **quickslot 2**, and you can change the slot in settings.
The score drops for runs that start with extra upgrade scrolls. Old scores are frozen as they were.
Damage-over-time forecasts use the live buffs. Clearer Arcana and Runic previews.
Fixed Healing Potion reset, monster idle flicker at 4x, Back button handling and CSV formula injection.
Optional **Waterskin** and **known-trap** confirmations, on by default.
Scoring is explained in-game.

- Removed inherited boss-key and victory **donation popups**. Credits and rewards are kept.\n- No more unlock notices for characters you can already play.\n- Reliable controls and a responsive menu footer.
